map.毛保费 = 10×(1+0.4) = 14。即每单位风险毛保费 14，其中 4: Gross premium = 10×(1+0.4) = 14. That is, the gross premium per risk unit is 14, of which 4 is loading for expenses and profit.
map.附加费率含哪些？: What does the loading rate include?
map.费用(获取+维持)、预期利润、风险安全边际。40% 是常见区间，渠道不同差异大。: Expenses (acquisition + maintenance), expected profit, and risk safety margin. 40% is a common range but varies greatly by channel.
map.偏高。附加费率含佣金（首年常20%–40%）、营运、税金、利润与安全边际；长期保: On the high side. The loading includes commission (often 20%–40% first year), operations, tax, profit and safety margin; long-term protection products usually carry 15%–30%, while unit-linked or online sales can be lower.
